description: This file defines the DefaultPluginManager class in Drupal, which manages plugin discovery, caching, and instantiation within the Drupal plugin API. It includes methods for setting cache backends, processing plugin definitions, and handling plugin discovery mechanisms.

classes.name: DefaultPluginManager
classes.description: A class that manages plugin discovery, caching, and instantiation in Drupal, supporting annotation and attribute-based discovery mechanisms, cache management, and plugin definition processing.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for DefaultPluginManager, initializes plugin manager with namespace, module handler, plugin interface, and annotation configurations.

methods.name: setCacheBackend
methods.description: Initializes cache backend with cache key and tags for plugin definitions.

methods.name: alterInfo
methods.description: Sets the name of the alter hook to modify plugin definitions.

methods.name: getDefinitions
methods.description: Retrieves plugin definitions, using cache if available.

methods.name: clearCachedDefinitions
methods.description: Clears cached plugin definitions and related cache tags.

methods.name: getCachedDefinitions
methods.description: Returns cached plugin definitions if available.

methods.name: useCaches
methods.description: Enables or disables caching for plugin discovery.

methods.name: processDefinition
methods.description: Performs additional processing on plugin definitions, such as merging defaults and normalizing class names.

methods.name: getDiscovery
methods.description: Creates and returns the plugin discovery mechanism based on annotations or attributes.

methods.name: getFactory
methods.description: Returns the factory responsible for instantiating plugins.

methods.name: findDefinitions
methods.description: Discovers plugin definitions, processes them, and applies hooks.

methods.name: extractProviderFromDefinition
methods.description: Extracts the provider string from a plugin definition.

methods.name: alterDefinitions
methods.description: Invokes the alter hook to modify plugin definitions.

methods.name: providerExists
methods.description: Checks if a plugin provider module exists.

methods.name: getCacheTags
methods.description: Returns cache tags associated with plugin definitions.
